discoveries:
- A `**Supersedes:** <ids alone>` line also makes a SUPERSEDES edge in `edges`, so the closure already holds it. It cannot serve as "named only by a stated link". Case 4 uses `**Changes:** DEC-404`, which gives AMENDS in `stated_links` and no edge. The README says this.
- Cases 3 and 4 could both be planted so the store records the link and no edge, so neither needed to be dropped.
- Stated links keep only links whose two ends are records. Each planted decision therefore has its own record file.

- Case 5 passes today, so it only guards against over-counting.
